result_text:
The parent landscape report no longer aborts when a sub-landscape's `config.json` is missing or unreadable. The fix is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in `addSubLandscapeLogoCell`.

The cause was that `getSubLandscapeConfig` returns null on failure, and the method then called `getMetadata()` on it. I added null checks so a null config, or null metadata, leaves the logo link null. The existing branch then renders the default landscape logo. The row still links to the sub-landscape's index page, and sub-landscapes with a config still show their own logo.

The module compiles, and the existing reports tests pass. The repo has no test that covers this path, so I did not run the generator against a broken sub-landscape. I also did not add a regression test, since the only code path involved is private. Nothing is committed.
